scripts.start: npm run content:sync && npm run start:outline
scripts.start:outline: cross-env OUTLINE_API_TOKEN= DOCS_CONTENT_SOURCE=outline npm run start:site
scripts.start:site: npm run mdx:normalize && npm run routes:check && npm run assets:check && npm run build:index && docusaurus start
scripts.build: npm run content:sync && npm run build:outline
scripts.build:outline: cross-env OUTLINE_API_TOKEN= DOCS_CONTENT_SOURCE=outline npm run build:active
scripts.build:active: npm run mdx:normalize && npm run routes:check && npm run assets:check && npm run build:index && npm run build:site
scripts.content:sync: cross-env NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=0 NO_PROXY=* no_proxy=* HTTP_PROXY= HTTPS_PROXY= ALL_PROXY= http_proxy= https_proxy= all_proxy= node ./scripts/sync-outline.mjs sync
scripts.content:routes:bootstrap: cross-env NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=0 NO_PROXY=* no_proxy=* HTTP_PROXY= HTTPS_PROXY= ALL_PROXY= http_proxy= https_proxy= all_proxy= node ./scripts/sync-outline.mjs bootstrap-routes
